comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
OGP steers the ship called UWO, but Admiral KOEI tells them where to head. No changes can be made to UWO without approval from the top brass, which is where a lot of the big changes came from to begin with (nerfs to dungeons, Nanban, piracy, etc.) in the first place. I don't see any alterations being made out on the Asian servers, and convincing the Admiral that any need to be made in GAMA's corner of the world seems dubious at best.

Not saying OGP doesn't have -any- influence on matters, or that some things could stand a tweak here or there. Just that OGP doesn't have as much absolute control as people keep implying they do.
